dublinCore.dc:title: 117 HR 2190 IH: Helping Homeless Veterans Act of 2021
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Ms. Brownley (for herself, Mr. Beyer, Mr. Lowenthal, Mr. Panetta, Mr. Hastings, Ms. Norton, Mr. Khanna, Ms. Chu, Mrs. Hayes, and Ms. Newman) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs

form.official-title: To amend title 38, United States Code, to make permanent certain programs that assist homeless veterans and other veterans with special needs, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Helping Homeless Veterans Act of 2021.

section.header: Programs assisting homeless veterans and other veterans with special needs

subsection.text: Section 2021(e)(1) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following:

subsection.header: Referral and counseling services for veterans at risk of homelessness who are transitioning from certain institutions
subsection.text: Section 2023 of such title is amended—

subsection.header: Treatment for seriously mentally ill and homeless veterans
subsection.text: Section 2031 of such title is amended—
Section 2041 of such title is amended by striking subsection (c).

subsection.header: Financial assistance for supportive services for very low-Income veteran families in permanent housing
subsection.text: Section 2044(e)(1) of such title is amended by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:

subparagraph.text: $420,000,000 for each fiscal year after fiscal year 2022.

subsection.header: Grant program for homeless veterans with special needs
subsection.text: Section 2061(d)(1) of such title is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking each of fiscal years 2007 through 2022 and inserting each fiscal year; and

subsection.text: Section 2066 of such title is amended by striking subsection (d).
